idle.hemClock: same local idle clock as wing; no independent random timer

blink.timingStatus: source explicitly labels 4 seconds demo-only; production cadence not frozen
blink.reschedule: when sampled >= nextBlink+240 and no wink, nextBlink=sampleTime+4000

wink.side: screen-left eye and same-side head tilt
wink.mutualExclusion: begin disables ordinary blink; wink end schedules next wink and next blink from scheduled wink end; wing/hem continue
wink.lateSample: source begins overdue wink at sample time, no catch-up replay

idle.interactionSuppression: ART034 draw does not sample WinkPreviewEngine during panic/held/release; final release completion constructs a new engine and idle local clock starts at releaseStart+540
idle.art029StandaloneDifference: standalone engine.press cancels wink, forces open; hemAt(dragging) returns base; engine.release schedules eye events but wing/hem retain global phase. ART034 full interaction supersedes that wrapper for integration reference.

interaction.intervalConvention: half-open [start,end); elapsed uses monotonic local time
interaction.press: cancel current release / interaction, capture last actually assigned image key, restart panic at press time
interaction.heldEnd: only release; never automatic mood softening
interaction.releaseRouting: idle sources -> normal/normal; pose sources split body-face-wing; half face routes normal. Source first60ms is exact current image, never resampled at release event.
interaction.symbol: fixed identical glyph and pout in annoyed A/B/C/H; no glyph in transition aliases or other poses; released annoyed H/C retain it, normal-half-B at260ms removes it; neutral at380ms; idle at540ms
interaction.regrabException: source-first60ms retains exact last image, including existing anger glyph if regrabbed from annoyed. New panic poses carry no glyph.
interaction.sourceMeaning: last PNG assigned to browser img src, not display-present receipt. Native equivalent and package-generation validity require PM/DEV contract.

transitionAliases.pose:transition-annoyed-C: byte copy of ART033 annoyed-annoyed-C, used panic620..700 and corresponding release C
transitionAliases.pose:transition-annoyed-H: byte copy of ART033 annoyed-annoyed-H, used early release from transition C

copyPolicy.artwork: copy exactly assets[].path byte-for-byte; all 64 logical keys must remain mapped even if storage deduplicates
copyPolicy.references: copy referenceFiles only as proposal evidence; do not execute preview build scripts or copy generation donors for runtime
exclude: historical formal frames/manifest on ART branch
ART030/031/032/033 artwork as alternate runtime inputs
copyPolicy.deduplication: duplicate keys are semantic aliases; production storage choice pending PM/DEV

notFrozenProductionSemantics: new package/schema version and manifest layout
native independent track scheduler and source snapshot schema
knownLimits: wink/closed eye source snapshot then head-face returns upright; hem resets to base may jump
finite pose/wing transitions are not universally seamless
original wing transparent pixel points retained
